gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Commanding from the first letter, Woodgod nearly lets its lowercase touch the capitals. Woodgod is best at making a statement, while Noto Sans Sunuwar is best at letting its open curves leave daylight on the page.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-syloti-n: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri reads tidy, its short ascenders keeping lines compact. Woodgod hits hard with a broad channel into each bowl, then the sans-serif text slips in with a tall x-height and an a that breathes.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac rounds its tall lowercase like blown glass bulbs. Woodgod is best at vintage command in big display letters, while the plain sans body is best at easy, wide turns in its s shapes.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Loud vintage swagger from Woodgod, lowercase almost touching its capitals. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, so the sans-serif text sits modern and open beneath that broad-bowled heading.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl. Further down, Noto Sans Telugu holds its midline high and its counters connected to the outside, so the sans text glides along without snagging.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Woodgod brings a wide channel into every bowl and lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, with a vintage, commanding air. Shared height wins: Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall bodies too.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, and its dominant x-height fills every line. Under Woodgod, the sans body reads easily from line to line.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square reads approachable and crisp, with a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes sharp. Woodgod adds vintage, commanding punch up top, and the sans lets it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-numans: Big vintage swagger over widely spaced type. The standout is texture: Numans swells its lowercase like rope coiled tight, then spaces it well past normal, against the tall lowercase of Woodgod.
gen-gf-agu-display-fs-rowan: Bent-wire loops, bold and distinctive: Agu Display looks like thin plastic tubing. Rowan adds friendly, generous curves, with thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones, though not for long paragraphs.
